You are applying for the following job...

Graphic Designer & Videographer

Posted by Auxato Limited

London
£29,000 - £34,000 per annum
Permanent

Salary: £29,000 - £34,000

Hybrid: London - 4 days a week in the office

A boutique social agency are looking for a creative, adaptable Graphic Designer & Videographer to join their close-knit team, someone who can turn ideas into polished visual output across both print and digital, and bring a strong instinct for what performs well on social media.

What you'll be doing:

  • Producing digital and print assets, from social graphics and infographics to branded materials for events and advertising
  • Shooting and editing video content across a range of formats and platforms, including short-form content for Reels, TikTok and Stories
  • Helping shape and evolve brand identities and visual guidelines for the agency and its clients
  • Building visually strong pitch decks and presentations
  • Supporting website content and design, with an eye on SEO and usability
  • Shooting, editing and retouching photography
  • Exploring AI-assisted image and video tools as part of the creative process
  • Working closely with account teams and clients to bring creative briefs to life

What they're looking for:

  • A degree in graphic design, photography, or a related creative discipline
  • A strong portfolio spanning design, photography, video and social content
  • Confident with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva and Figma, plus video editing tools such as CapCut
  • Comfortable with website platforms and basic plugin/content management
  • Solid understanding of photography equipment, lighting and post-production
  • A collaborative, deadline-driven mindset and excellent communication skills
  • Experience working across varied industries and client types
  • This is a great opportunity to join a small, values-led team with genuine ownership over creative projects from concept through to delivery.

If this is you, apply now!

Your Privacy

When you visit a website, it may store or access information in your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information can relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is primarily used to make the site function as expected. While it doesn’t usually identify you directly, it can help provide a more tailored online experience. Because we value your privacy, you can choose to turn off certain types of cookies. Use the category headings to learn more and adjust your settings. Please note that disabling some cookies may affect how the site works and the services we can provide.
More information

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Functional Cookies

Active

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Performance Cookies

Active

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Targeting Cookies

Active

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
